The interior timed lights work if controlled manually and when the doors are opened, but the time period is not activated when the remote control is operated (the door lock/unlock works normally) (If the door lock does not work see Table P10-P11).

When one of the side doors is opened, the courtesy light is turned on for a period of 3 minutes. When the car is unlocked after activation of the remote control, the courtesy light is switched on for a period of 15 seconds, which is interrupted by the ignition ON signal. If the ignition ON signal is present following the opening of a door, the courtesy light comes on.
